name: char
summary: The text made of the given Unicode code points.

name: concat
summary: Joins the values as text, skipping NULLs.

name: concat_ws
summary: Joins the values with the separator, skipping NULLs.

name: format
summary: Formats values like printf.

name: glob
summary: Case-sensitive match with * and ?, like text GLOB pattern.

name: hex
summary: The value's bytes as upper-case hexadecimal.

name: instr
summary: The position of the first occurrence of find (from 1), or 0.

name: length
summary: The number of characters.

name: like
summary: Case-insensitive match with % and _, like text LIKE pattern.

name: lower
summary: The text in lower case (ASCII letters).

name: ltrim
summary: Removes spaces (or the given characters) from the start.

name: octet_length
summary: The number of bytes.

name: printf
summary: Formats values: %d, %f, %s, %.2f, %05d and the other printf patterns.

name: quote
summary: The value written as a SQL literal.

name: replace
summary: Replaces every occurrence of find.

name: rtrim
summary: Removes spaces (or the given characters) from the end.

name: substr
summary: Part of the text; start counts from 1, a negative start from the end.

name: substring
summary: The same as substr.

name: trim
summary: Removes spaces (or the given characters) from both ends.

name: typeof
summary: The storage class: 'null', 'integer', 'real', 'text' or 'blob'.

name: unhex
summary: The bytes the hexadecimal text stands for.

name: unicode
summary: The code point of the first character.

name: upper
summary: The text in upper case (ASCII letters).

name: abs
summary: The number without its sign.

name: acos
summary: Arccosine, in radians.

name: acosh
summary: Inverse hyperbolic cosine.

name: asin
summary: Arcsine, in radians.

name: asinh
summary: Inverse hyperbolic sine.

name: atan
summary: Arctangent, in radians.

name: atan2
summary: The angle of the point (x, y), in radians.

name: atanh
summary: Inverse hyperbolic tangent.

name: ceil
summary: The smallest whole number not below it.

name: ceiling
summary: The same as ceil.

name: cos
summary: Cosine.

name: cosh
summary: Hyperbolic cosine.

name: degrees
summary: Converts radians to degrees.

name: exp
summary: e raised to the number.

name: floor
summary: The largest whole number not above it.

name: ln
summary: The natural logarithm.

name: log
summary: The base-10 logarithm, or the logarithm in the given base.

name: log10
summary: The base-10 logarithm.

name: log2
summary: The base-2 logarithm.

name: mod
summary: The remainder of a divided by b, as a real number.

name: pi
summary: π.

name: pow
summary: base raised to exponent.

name: power
summary: The same as pow.

name: radians
summary: Converts degrees to radians.

name: random
summary: A random integer. Queries only.

name: round
summary: Rounded to the given number of decimal places (default 0).

name: sin
summary: Sine.

name: sinh
summary: Hyperbolic sine.

name: sqrt
summary: The square root.

name: tan
summary: Tangent.

name: tanh
summary: Hyperbolic tangent.

name: trunc
summary: The whole part, towards zero.

name: coalesce
summary: The first value that is not NULL.

name: if
summary: The same as iif; more condition and value pairs may follow.

name: ifnull
summary: a, or b when a is NULL.

name: iif
summary: then when the condition is true, otherwise else.

name: likelihood
summary: The value; a hint for the query planner.

name: likely
summary: The value; a hint for the query planner.

name: max
summary: The largest of the values (NULL if any is NULL). In a query, max(column) is the largest value in the group.

name: max
summary: The largest of the values (NULL if any is NULL). In a query, max(column) is the largest value in the group.

name: min
summary: The smallest of the values (NULL if any is NULL). In a query, min(column) is the smallest value in the group.

name: min
summary: The smallest of the values (NULL if any is NULL). In a query, min(column) is the smallest value in the group.

name: nullif
summary: NULL when a equals b, otherwise a.

name: unlikely
summary: The value; a hint for the query planner.

name: date
summary: The date as YYYY-MM-DD. Modifiers such as '+1 day', 'start of month'. date('now') is today (defaults only).

name: datetime
summary: The date and time as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

name: julianday
summary: The Julian day number; subtract two to get the days between dates.

name: strftime
summary: Formats a date: %Y year, %m month, %d day, %H:%M:%S time, %W week, %w weekday.

name: time
summary: The time as HH:MM:SS.

name: timediff
summary: The time from b to a, as ±YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.SSS.

name: unixepoch
summary: Seconds since 1970-01-01.

name: json
summary: The JSON text, minified; an error if it is not JSON.

name: json_array
summary: A JSON array of the values.

name: json_array_length
summary: The number of elements in the array.

name: json_error_position
summary: 0 for valid JSON, otherwise the position of the first error.

name: json_extract
summary: The value at the path, such as '$.items[0].name'.

name: json_insert
summary: Adds values where the paths don't exist yet.

name: json_object
summary: A JSON object of the key and value pairs.

name: json_patch
summary: Applies an RFC 7396 merge patch.

name: json_quote
summary: The value as a JSON value.

name: json_remove
summary: Removes the values at the paths.

name: json_replace
summary: Replaces values where the paths exist.

name: json_set
summary: Sets values, adding or replacing.

name: json_type
summary: The JSON type at the path: 'object', 'array', 'text', 'integer', 'real', 'true', 'false' or 'null'.

name: json_valid
summary: 1 when the text is valid JSON.

name: geo_area_m2
summary: The area's size in square metres.

name: geo_bbox
summary: The area's bounding box, as [west, south, east, north].

name: geo_centroid
summary: The area's centre.

name: geo_distance_m
summary: The distance between two locations, in metres.

name: geo_lat
summary: The latitude of a location.

name: geo_lon
summary: The longitude of a location.

name: geo_point
summary: A location from latitude and longitude.

name: geo_within
summary: 1 when the location is inside the area.

name: avg
summary: The average of the group's values. Queries only.

name: count
summary: The number of values (or rows) in the group. Queries only.

name: group_concat
summary: The group's values joined with commas (or the separator). Queries only.

name: sum
summary: The sum of the group's values. Queries only.

name: total
summary: The sum of the group's values, 0.0 when there are none. Queries only.
